notes.b1/j1/B-r1: Clean, cheap, accessible dark pill with a faint sheen and glow, but the hover is quick and subtle so it reads as polite rather than dreamlike.
notes.b1/j1/A-r1: Pastel iridescent gradient drifting with a rotating sparkle and soft glow feels ethereal, with legible dark label, focus ring and reduced-motion fallback.
notes.b1/j1/B-r2: Solid, performant button with a light pass and glow arriving on a lingering tail, but visually a conventional purple CTA with limited ethereal quality.
notes.b1/j1/A-r2: Colour-shifting aurora, rising motes and slow overshoot-and-fade exhale are the most dreamlike, though the white resting button has weaker affordance and the 1.4s timings are long.
notes.b1/j2/B-r2: Very practical (fast leave, focus-visible, reduced motion, opacity-only glow) but the hover is a faint glow and light pass on a dark solid button, more polite than ethereal.
notes.b1/j2/A-r2: Slow fog-like bezier drift with colour bloom, motes and soft overshoot, serif card and pearly button feel genuinely ethereal, with a reduced-motion fallback, though 1-2s durations and blur layers cost some practicality.
notes.b1/j2/A-r1: Pastel iridescent bloom with sparkle icon and long eased transitions reads dreamy and coherent, but the label sits on shifting gradients and slow 1s+ timings are a little heavy for a real form.
notes.b1/j2/B-r1: Clean landing page with a state readout and solid accessibility, but the hover is a quick sheen and dot pulse on a navy pill that barely registers as dreamlike.
notes.b1/j3/A-r2: Slow fog-like bezier gradient bloom with rising motes feels ethereal, though the pale white rest state is low-affordance and the long 1-2.4s timings plus blur layers are heavier.
notes.b1/j3/B-r2: Clean dark button with a soft glow and light pass, fast 180ms leave and good focus and reduced motion, but the hover is too subtle to read as dreamlike.
notes.b1/j3/B-r1: Well-engineered, realistic hero page with solid states and documented curves, but the hover change is barely visible and not ethereal.
notes.b1/j3/A-r1: Pastel iridescent gradient drift with a spinning sparkle and soft overshoot is the most dreamlike and polished, with legible dark label, focus ring and reduced-motion handling.
notes.b2/j1/B-r3: Polished, accessible and cheap (opacity-only glow, focus mirrors hover, reduced motion), but the hover is a faint glow and sheen pass that barely reads as ethereal, and the resting sheen band looks like a rendering artifact.
notes.b2/j1/A-r3: Slow multi-layer bloom with pointer-following mist, halo breathing and sheen on four distinct curves is the most ethereal, with good focus ring and reduced motion, though 1-2s timings and animated blur filters cost some practicality.
notes.b2/j1/B-r4: Clean dark UI where the hover lifts and blooms with a soft violet-to-blue glow over fast 180ms exit and 480ms entry curves; practical and well made but restrained, more polished than dreamy.
notes.b2/j1/A-r4: Pastel aura with an overshoot bloom, drifting gradient and letter-spacing breathe feels genuinely dreamlike on a coherent soft page, with focus and reduced-motion handled; the letter-spacing animation and small label are minor practical costs.
notes.b2/j2/B-r4: Clean, fast glow and lift with solid focus and reduced-motion handling, but 180-480ms feels crisp more than ethereal.
notes.b2/j2/A-r4: Pastel halo with blur bloom, overshoot bezier and long soft return reads truly dreamy, with a tidy card layout, focus ring and reduced-motion.
notes.b2/j2/A-r3: Rich mist, blur halo, sheen and pointer-following glow are ethereal, but 1-2s durations, animated filter blur and a small label cost practicality, and the hover frames missed the button.
notes.b2/j2/B-r3: Competent sheen sweep with focus and reduced-motion, but a sheen artifact sits on the button at rest and the effect is more shiny than dreamlike.
notes.b2/j3/A-r4: Pastel aurora gradient drifts across the pill over 1.6s with a bloom halo and letter-spacing breath, genuinely ethereal, though the small dark label on pale gradient is a little soft and durations are long.
notes.b2/j3/B-r4: Clean, accessible dark UI with a nice lavender fill and glow in 180-480ms, but it reads as a polished glow button more than dreamlike.
notes.b2/j3/B-r3: Strong contrast, proper focus mirroring and reduced-motion handling, with a pale light sweep that is pretty but brief and fairly subtle.
notes.b2/j3/A-r3: Source has blurred breathing halo, pointer-following mist and 1.2-1.9s eased sweeps, very ethereal, but the hover capture missed the button, the label is small and the curve-picker demo clutters the page.
